prompt_en:
Compare the departments based on the document and identify differences and missing information.

Document (fictional data):
Line 1. Sara, responsible for the building services department, reports case P13-000, status approved, budget 1564 euros, deadline 2026-11-14. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 2. Tommaso, responsible for the structures department, reports case P13-001, status suspended, budget 2371 euros, deadline 2026-11-15. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 3. Anna, responsible for the construction department, reports case P13-002, status under review, budget 6605 euros, deadline 2026-11-16. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 4. Bruno, responsible for the building services department, reports case P13-003, status approved, budget 2760 euros, deadline 2026-11-17. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 5. Carla, responsible for the structures department, reports case P13-004, status approved, budget 4158 euros, deadline 2026-11-18. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 6. Diego, responsible for the construction department, reports case P13-005, status suspended, budget 2965 euros, deadline 2026-11-19. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 7. Elena, responsible for the building services department, reports case P13-006, status under review, budget 7913 euros, deadline to be defined. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 8. Fabio, responsible for the structures department, reports case P13-007, status approved, budget 1950 euros, deadline 2026-11-21. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 9. Giulia, responsible for the construction department, reports case P13-008, status approved, budget 8431 euros, deadline 2026-11-22. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 10. Irene, responsible for the building services department, reports case P13-009, status suspended, budget 2434 euros, deadline 2026-11-23. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 11. The proposal to bring all deadlines forward has not been approved. The stated amounts are estimates, not actual costs.

Keep the answer concise: at most about 120 words, or the requested code or data. Do not include internal reasoning.
